WITH store_1998 AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        c_first_name customer_first_name,
        c_last_name customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country customer_birth_country,
        c_login customer_login,
        c_email_address customer_email_address,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM 
        customer, store_sales, date_dim
    WHERE 
        c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address
),
store_1999 AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        c_first_name customer_first_name,
        c_last_name customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country customer_birth_country,
        c_login customer_login,
        c_email_address customer_email_address,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM 
        customer, store_sales, date_dim
    WHERE 
        c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address
),
web_1998 AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        c_first_name customer_first_name,
        c_last_name customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country customer_birth_country,
        c_login customer_login,
        c_email_address customer_email_address,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM 
        customer, web_sales, date_dim
    WHERE 
        c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address
),
web_1999 AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        c_first_name customer_first_name,
        c_last_name customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country customer_birth_country,
        c_login customer_login,
        c_email_address customer_email_address,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM 
        customer, web_sales, date_dim
    WHERE 
        c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address
)
SELECT 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
FROM 
    store_1998 t_s_firstyear
JOIN 
    store_1999 t_s_secyear ON t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN 
    web_1998 t_w_firstyear ON t_w_firstyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN 
    web_1999 t_w_secyear ON t_w_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
WHERE 
    t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
    AND t_s_secyear.year_total * t_w_firstyear.year_total > t_w_secyear.year_total * t_s_firstyear.year_total
ORDER BY 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
